name: SUBSTITUTE
description: SUBSTITUTE replaces one text string with another in a text string.
tldr: SUBSTITUTE replaces specific text within a string with new text.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text string in which to substitute characters.

parameters.name: old_text
parameters.description: The text to find and replace.

parameters.name: new_text
parameters.description: The text to replace old_text with.

parameters.name: instance_num
parameters.description: Optional. Which occurrence of old_text to replace.

advancedExamples.title: Replace only the first occurrence
advancedExamples.description: Replace just the first instance of text

advancedExamples.title: Remove all spaces
advancedExamples.description: Delete all spaces from a text string
advancedExamples.explanation: Replaces every space with nothing, effectively removing them.

howItWorks: SUBSTITUTE searches for old_text in the text string and replaces it with new_text. If instance_num is specified, only that occurrence is replaced.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the modified text.

limitations: For case-insensitive replacement, use UPPER/LOWER with SUBSTITUTE, or use REPLACE for position-based replacement.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure all required arguments are provided.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: SUBSTITUTE works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is SUBSTITUTE case-sensitive?
faq.answer: Yes, "Apple" and "apple" are treated as different.

faq.question: What is the difference between SUBSTITUTE and REPLACE?
faq.answer: SUBSTITUTE replaces text by content; REPLACE replaces text by position.
